transactions.title: Purchase of merchandise on account
transactions.description: The company purchased inventory worth $15,000 from a supplier on credit. Payment is due next month.

transactions.title: Collection from customer
transactions.description: A customer paid $5,000 previously owed to the company on account. Funds deposited directly into the bank.
options: Debit: Sales Revenue | Credit: Accounts Receivable

transactions.title: Accrual of monthly salaries
transactions.description: The business recorded employee salaries for the current month amounting to $12,000, to be paid on payday.
options: Debit: Salaries Expense | Credit: Salaries Payable
Debit: Operating Expenses | Credit: Accounts Payable
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Salaries Expense | Credit: Salaries Payable

transactions.title: Payment to supplier
transactions.description: The company paid $8,000 to its main supplier via bank transfer to settle an outstanding invoice.

transactions.title: Issuance of short-term bank loan
transactions.description: The bank approved and transferred a short-term loan of $50,000 directly to the company's checking account.
options: Debit: Cash | Credit: Short-term Notes Payable
Debit: Short-term Notes Payable | Credit: Cash
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Cash | Credit: Short-term Notes Payable

transactions.title: Owner's capital contribution
transactions.description: The owner invested an additional $25,000 of personal funds into the business bank account.
options: Debit: Cash | Credit: Common Stock (or Owner's Capital)
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Cash | Credit: Common Stock (or Owner's Capital)

transactions.title: Depreciation of equipment
transactions.description: Recorded monthly depreciation on office and store equipment in the amount of $2,500.
options: Debit: Depreciation Expense | Credit: Accumulated Depreciation
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Depreciation Expense | Credit: Accumulated Depreciation

transactions.title: Cash sale of goods
transactions.description: The retail store sold goods for $4,000 in cash. The customer received the merchandise immediately.
options: Debit: Accounts Receivable | Credit: Sales Revenue

transactions.title: Purchase of office supplies for cash
transactions.description: The company bought stationery and printer paper for $600, paying immediately from petty cash.
options: Debit: Supplies Expense (or Supplies) | Credit: Cash
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Supplies Expense (or Supplies) | Credit: Cash

transactions.title: Prepayment of annual insurance
transactions.description: Paid $12,000 in advance for a 1-year commercial insurance policy covering upcoming months.
options: Debit: Insurance Expense | Credit: Accounts Payable

transactions.title: Receipt of customer advance payment
transactions.description: A client paid $10,000 in advance for future consulting services that will be delivered next month.
options: Debit: Accounts Receivable | Credit: Unearned Revenue

transactions.title: Payment of utility bill
transactions.description: The company received and immediately paid the monthly electricity and water bill of $1,800 via bank transfer.
options: Debit: Operating Expenses | Credit: Utilities Expense

transactions.title: Declaration of dividends
transactions.description: The board of directors declared cash dividends of $10,000 to shareholders, payable next month.
options: Debit: Retained Earnings (or Dividends) | Credit: Dividends Payable
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Retained Earnings (or Dividends) | Credit: Dividends Payable

transactions.title: Payment of advertising expenses on credit
transactions.description: The firm placed an ad in a local magazine for $3,500, receiving an invoice due in 30 days.
options: Debit: Advertising Expense | Credit: Accounts Payable
Debit: Accounts Payable | Credit: Advertising Expense
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Advertising Expense | Credit: Accounts Payable

transactions.title: Recognition of cost of goods sold
transactions.description: Following a product sale, the company recorded the cost of inventory sold, amounting to $2,400.
options: Debit: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) | Credit: Inventory
Debit: Inventory | Credit: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)
transactions.correct_answer: Debit: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) | Credit: Inventory
